name: Advanced Algorithm Problem Analysis Service
description: Provides detailed analysis for challenging algorithm problems for computer science students.
content: Algorithm problem-solving service provided by ACM Gold Medal winners, including analysis and guidance for advanced algorithm problems such as dynamic programming, graph theory, and network flow. Each service includes a written analysis and a 30-minute online explanation.

name: Advanced Mathematics Tutoring
description: One-on-one tutoring for challenging advanced math problems such as calculus and linear algebra.
content: Advanced mathematics problem explanation service provided by mathematics PhD students, covering topics such as calculus, linear algebra, probability theory, and mathematical statistics. Each service includes problem analysis and a 45-minute one-on-one online tutoring session.

name: Academic Paper Polishing and Editing
description: Provides professional language polishing and content editing services for academic papers.
content: Academic paper polishing service provided by professors and PhDs with rich academic backgrounds, including optimization of language expression, adjustment of logical structure, and standardization of citation formats. Applicable to undergraduate theses, master's/doctoral dissertations, and academic journal submissions.

name: Physics Experiment Data Analysis
description: Provides data processing and analysis services for physics, chemistry, and other experimental courses.
content: Experimental data analysis service provided by lab teaching assistants, including data organization, error analysis, chart plotting, and conclusion writing. Applicable to various science and engineering experimental courses at the university level.

name: Programming Assignment Guidance
description: Tutoring services for assignments in various programming languages and frameworks.
content: Programming assignment guidance provided by senior software engineers, covering mainstream languages like Java, Python, and C++, as well as popular areas like web development and machine learning. Offers code review, debugging guidance, and best practice recommendations.

name: Graduate Entrance Exam Math Crash Course
description: Key problem type explanation and mock training for graduate entrance exam mathematics.
content: High-intensity tutoring service provided by a perfect scorer in graduate entrance exam mathematics, including analysis of past exam questions, breakthrough in key problem types, teaching problem-solving techniques, and mock tests. Applicable to Math I, Math II, and Math III for the graduate entrance exam.

name: Academic English Writing Guidance
description: Provides academic English writing guidance and training for non-native English speakers.
content: Academic English writing guidance provided by a TESOL certified teacher, helping students master the norms and techniques of academic paper and report writing, and improve their academic English expression skills. Includes writing demonstrations, personalized feedback, and revision suggestions.

name: Research Project Design Consulting
description: Provides guidance on research project design and execution for undergraduate and graduate students.
content: Research project consulting service provided by experienced researchers, including research question design, methodology selection, experimental protocol development, and data collection and analysis suggestions. Applicable to beginners in research across various disciplines.

name: Northwestern University Campus Tour
description: Personalized campus tour guide service provided by current students.
content: 2-hour campus tour service provided by current Northwestern University students, taking you to visit iconic campus buildings, colleges, libraries, sports facilities, etc., sharing interesting facts about campus life and practical information, and offering photo opportunities.

name: New Student Course Selection Guidance
description: Professional course selection advice and planning provided by upperclassmen.
content: Personalized course selection guidance service provided by 3rd and 4th-year students, recommending suitable course combinations based on your interests, career plans, and academic background, sharing teaching styles and assessment methods of different professors, and helping you create an ideal study plan.

name: Study Abroad Life Adaptation Guide
description: Campus and city life adaptation service provided for international students.
content: Study abroad adaptation service provided by senior students with rich study abroad experience, including coping with cultural differences, guide to purchasing essential daily necessities, opening a bank account, applying for a mobile phone card, recommendations for social activities, and other practical information to help you quickly integrate into campus and local life.

name: Academic Resource Utilization Guidance
description: Consulting service to help new students efficiently utilize on- and off-campus academic resources.
content: Guidance on using academic resources provided by library student assistants, including library resource search techniques, database usage methods, academic software applications, and introduction to research support services, to help you make full use of the academic resources provided by the school and improve research and learning efficiency.

name: Student Organizations and Activities Introduction
description: Detailed introduction to various on-campus student organizations and activities, with participation guidance.
content: Consulting service on student organizations and activities provided by student union members, recommending suitable student organizations and clubs based on your interests and hobbies, introducing important campus events and traditions, providing information on how to join and contact persons, to help you expand your social circle and enrich your campus life.

name: Internship and Career Guidance
description: Job search preparation and internship application guidance provided by career center student advisors.
content: Employment and internship consulting service provided by senior student advisors from the career center, including resume and cover letter modification, interview skills training, internship opportunity recommendations, and industry information sharing, offering personalized advice based on your major field and career goals.

name: Off-Campus Housing Options Consulting
description: Provides advice on surrounding housing options for students planning to move off campus.
content: Housing consulting service provided by upperclassmen with rich off-campus living experience, including safety evaluation of each community, rent level comparison, transportation convenience analysis, landlord credibility investigation, precautions for signing leases, and other practical information to help you find ideal off-campus housing.

name: Academic Integrity and Paper Writing Norms
description: Helps international students understand Western academic norms and avoid academic misconduct.
content: Academic integrity guidance service provided by writing center tutors, explaining in detail Western academic norms, citation formats, plagiarism definition standards, providing suggestions for paper writing and methods for citing academic resources, to help you effectively avoid academic misconduct and improve paper quality.

name: Paris In-Depth Cultural Tour
description: Exploring niche Parisian attractions led by a local art history expert.
content: Skip the crowded Eiffel Tower and the Louvre, and follow a local Parisian art history expert to explore little-known museums, historic districts, and art spaces. The 6-hour itinerary includes visits to 3 niche attractions, an authentic French lunch experience, and professional cultural explanations, limited to a small group of 4 people to ensure an in-depth experience.

name: Kyoto Traditional Craft Experience
description: Private workshop to experience traditional Japanese handicraft making.
content: In the studio of a local artisan in Kyoto, experience traditional Washi paper making, woodblock printing, or kimono dyeing. The 3-hour workshop includes professional guidance, all material costs, finished product shipping service, and a tea ceremony experience, taking you to appreciate the essence of Japanese craftsmanship.

name: New York Underground Music Scene Exploration
description: Night tour delving into New York's underground music scene.
content: Led by a seasoned music journalist, explore the little-known underground music scenes in Brooklyn and Queens, New York. The 5-hour itinerary includes VIP access to 3 independent music venues, opportunities to interact with local musicians, tasting of signature cocktails, and overnight transportation arrangements.

name: Morocco Sahara Stargazing Camping
description: Authentic in-depth Sahara desert camping experience.
content: Experience authentic Berber camping life in the real Sahara Desert. The 2-day, 1-night itinerary includes camel riding, traditional tent accommodation, authentic Moroccan dinner, stargazing photography guidance, sunrise viewing over the dunes in the morning, and bonfire music performance.

name: Venice Gondola Restoration Workshop
description: Visit and participate in the traditional gondola boat restoration process.
content: In a traditional Venetian boatyard, witness and participate in the process of restoring a gondola boat. The 3-hour experience includes a demonstration of the boat builder's skills, basic woodworking instruction, participation in actual restoration work, and a private gondola tour, personally guided by a third-generation owner of a family-run boatyard.

name: Chiang Mai Street Food Cooking Class
description: Full Thai cuisine experience from market sourcing to cooking.
content: Follow a local chef starting from a traditional market in Chiang Mai to learn how to select fresh ingredients, then learn to cook 4 authentic Northern Thai dishes in an outdoor kitchen. The 6-hour itinerary includes a market tour, cooking instruction, enjoying the finished dishes, a recipe booklet, and a special spice gift package.

name: Iceland Northern Lights Chasing Private Guide
description: Northern Lights viewing and photography led by a professional photographer.
content: Led by a professional Northern Lights photographer, go to the best viewing spots in Iceland based on real-time weather and aurora forecast data. The 4-6 hour itinerary includes warm clothing, hot drinks, photography guidance, tripod rental, and professional post-processing services for photos.

name: Rio de Janeiro Carnival Dance Workshop
description: Participate in the Carnival preparation process at a Brazilian samba school.
content: Experience the preparation process for the Rio Carnival at a real samba school. The 3-hour workshop includes basic samba steps instruction, Carnival costume try-on experience, drum rhythm training, and a small parade performance, taught by professional dancers and includes video recording service.

name: Crazy Compliment Service
description: Professional-level flattery and praise to boost your confidence.
content: 30-minute crazy compliment service provided by professional 'rainbow farts' creators. No matter what you did or failed at today, we can tell you from 100 angles why you are the best. Includes customized praise, creative metaphors, expressive recitation, and a personalized compliment certificate.

name: Professional Venting Listener
description: Lets you speak freely and pour out all your troubles without interruption.
content: 45-minute venting service provided by experienced 'professional listeners'. You can complain about anything without hesitation: work, studies, relationships, daily瑣事... We are only responsible for listening and empathizing, never interrupting, never judging, and also provide exclusive emotional release dolls and virtual check-in certificates.

name: Absurd Reason Generator
description: Provides creative excuses for your mistakes and procrastination.
content: Excuse customization service provided by senior creative writers. Whether you missed a deadline, forgot an appointment, or didn't finish a task, we can provide 5 convincing and creative excuses, including necessary detail descriptions and suggestions on how to respond to questions, making your explanation impeccable.

name: Contrary Opinion Provider
description: No matter the decision, we will support the opposite choice.
content: 30-minute consulting service provided by professional 'contrarians'. No matter which option you lean towards, we will strongly argue why the opposite decision is better. Helps you comprehensively examine issues, consider factors you might have overlooked, or simply satisfy your desire for debate.

name: Professional Blame Service
description: Blame all problems on us and release your guilt.
content: Emotional release service provided by 'professional scapegoats'. You can blame us for any problem, and we will sincerely accept the blame and apologize, helping you release guilt and stress. Includes a written apology letter, voice apology, and 50 creative ways to say 'I was wrong'.

name: Achievement Magnifier
description: Packages your small achievements into earth-shattering successes.
content: Personal achievement packaging service provided by marketing experts, turning your daily small victories (like waking up on time, finishing chores) into major achievements comparable to Nobel Prizes. Includes professional rhetoric, data visualization, achievement certificates, and social media promotional copy to boost your self-recognition.

name: Virtual Social Circle Likes Squad
description: Provides genuine interaction and enthusiastic feedback for your social media.
content: Social media interaction team composed of 10 real people, providing likes, comments, and shares for any of your social media content. No matter how ordinary the content is, we will provide enthusiastic comments and sincere interactions, allowing you to experience the attention and recognition of a 'social media celebrity'.

name: Life Script Rewriting Service
description: Creates an enviable parallel universe version for your past.
content: 'What If Life Started Over' narrative service provided by creative writing experts, creating a completely different but reasonable and believable life script based on your real experiences, satisfying your curiosity about 'what if I had chosen...'. Includes a detailed description of the life trajectory, analysis of key decision points, and an exquisite life branch diagram.
